transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately, or what brings you in today?

Um... I don't know. Just... things at work have been hard. My hands feel like they’re moving through glue or something. Like, even just sectioning hair or mixing color... it takes me forever now. People have started noticing I’m just slower than I used to be.
How long have you been feeling like your hands are moving through glue?
Um... a while, I guess. Maybe like... a year and eight months? It just sort of started back when they cut my hours at the salon. My savings started draining away, and... yeah. Around then.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah... I guess so. I don't really... I used to talk to my clients a lot more. And help the newer girls at the salon. I even used to go hiking with my friends. But now... I just kind of keep my head down. I mostly just try to avoid people. I don't know, I just... don't really have that spark in me anymore.
Have you found yourself feeling like a failure or blaming yourself for things that aren’t your fault lately?

Um... yeah. I guess. I just... I feel like I'm dragging everyone down. Like I'm just a burden now. And... I don't know, maybe I deserve all this. If I had just... been better at my job, or kept my savings together... maybe things wouldn't be like this. I just... I couldn't even handle basic stuff at the salon. So... yeah. It's my fault.
Have you had times in the past where you felt this way before, or is this the first time you've felt like this?
Um... I don't really know. Maybe? I... I can't really remember if it was exactly like this before. It's just... hard to think back right now.
Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had any other periods in your life where you felt this low or down for a long time before?
I... I really don't know. It's just... hard to remember. I don't think so.
Can you think back to any time before this current period when you felt down or hopeless for more than two weeks at a time?
I... I'm really not sure. I just... I can't think of anything like that right now.
Can you think back to any time before the past year and eight months when you felt down or hopeless for more than two weeks at a time?
I mean... no. Like I said, I just... I don't remember feeling like this before then. I really don't think so.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for more than two weeks in a row?
I... I don't really know how else to answer that. I just... no. Nothing before this.

Have you ever had any other episodes in your life before this one where you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced a major change in your energy or mood that lasted for more than two weeks?
I just... I keep telling you. No. I haven't. I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. There wasn't anything before this.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
I... no. I already said no. I don't have a different answer for you.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you experienced a major drop in mood, loss of interest, or changes in energy that lasted for more than two weeks?
I don't... I really don't understand why you keep asking me this. I haven't. There wasn't anything else. Just... just this.
Before this current period, have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
I... no. I don't know what else you want me to say to that. Just... no.

Have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had a major change in your mood or energy that lasted for more than two weeks at a time, even if it was a long time ago?
I'm... I'm not answering this again. I already told you no. I don't know why you keep repeating yourself.
Have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time, even if it was a long time ago or not as severe?
I just... I'm done answering this. I've said no three times. Please stop asking me the same thing over and over.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced a major change in your mood or energy that lasted for more than two weeks?
I... I'm not answering this again. I don't... I don't know why you're doing this. I've already told you no. I'm not going to keep repeating myself.

Dysthymia (F34.1) is not included as a candidate as the current symptom pattern suggests a more acute and severe episode.
